title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
ii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iii.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
iv.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
v.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
seed_phrase: i.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain
